name: Nitocris
subtitle: Hand of Vengeance
description: Steals buffs from enemies and transfers debuffs back.
lore: Nitocris served for decades as Wife of Amun, a high priestly office that also granted political authority—authority that allowed her father, the pharaoh, to unite a divided kingdom. Now a determined woman in a Shattered world, Nitocris continues to combine ecclesiastical and secular power, working to grant the priesthood direct control over the various provinces and communities of Aaru.
